prompt: Why has the lead stopped the crew from washing the floor with the machine?
promptZh: 為什麼領班不讓清潔班用這台機器洗地？

options.text: The machine cannot be moved downstairs.
options.whyZh: 對話沒有提到機器搬不動；領班只是說自己要上樓。

options.text: The strip that collects water is damaged.
options.zh: 用來收水的橡膠條壞了。
options.whyZh: 領班指出橡膠條破了，因此今天下午不能用它洗地。

options.text: The machine has lost its dry head.
options.zh: 機器的乾式吸頭不見了。
options.whyZh: 乾式吸頭仍可用，故障的是收水的橡膠條。

options.text: There is no water in the supply room.
options.whyZh: 物料間是掛橡膠條的地方，沒有說那裡缺水。

explanationZh: 領班指出橡膠條破了，因此今天下午不能用它洗地。
evidence: The rubber strip that picks up water on the scrubber has torn.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The rubber strip that picks up water on the scrubber has torn.

vocabulary.note: 此處是洗地機上回收水的膠條
tear 的現在完成式，指出破損仍影響使用
